text: This Motion is required to allow for flexibility to City of Toronto staff regarding the issuance of tax bills and the requirements for proper public notice. It is urgent as the next batch of tax bills is expected to be issued prior to the next City Council meeting.

City Council on May 14, 15, 2019, adopted the following: 1. Notwithstanding sections 8, 9 and 10 of By-law 394-2019, City Council direct the Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer to report to the June or July Executive Committee meeting with recommendations for revised dates for the issuance of tax Bills and revised tax due dates for 2019.
